title: Arcanum_and_Obsidian
description: That day, Obsidian had a dream of becoming a material that could make equipment. In that dream, it could be made into equipment, weapons, and tools, thinking that it could continue like this forever. Until his dream woke up……
body:
This mod will add a lot of cool things to your world! You can try using obsidian to make things, which is a cool thing, and now you can try eating carrion to scare away zombies, eating fallen limbs of zombies, and if you like explosions, then I have prepared a unique bomb for you! If you don't have anything to eat, you can make something from soil to eat. If you enjoy fighting, then I have prepared unique equipment and weapons for you. Anyway, enjoy it to the fullest!PS: This mod is suitable for adding to some medium-sized mod integration packages
Specific new mechanisms and items
1. Obsidian Upgrade Template  All obsidian equipment requires its synthesis
2. Purple diamond alloy ingot  Can further upgrade obsidian equipment
3. Composite steel  The equipment and weapons produced all come with damage bonus entries
4. copper alloy  The weapons made have high damage and high cooldown
5. Never Dies Totem  To instantly resurrect you when you are on the brink of death and give you infinite power
6. Obsidian Giant Leader Boss  High health, a bit foolish, killing can obtain important materials
7. Ultimate Obsidian Zombie Leader Boss  High health, high damage, high defense, able to summon zombies
8. Original item formula extension  Allow you to synthesize small parts of things that were previously impossible to synthesize
9. Zombies drop 1-2 legs and arms  Zombie cuisine
10. Eating carrion scares away zombies   Zombie: Oh my god, that human is eating our own kind!
11. Obsidian series equipment  Resist damage and protect you
12. Obsidian lower bound alloy equipment  Higher defense
13. Ultimate Bomb and Super Bomb  Bomb the world!
14. rocket launcher  A very useful and powerful weapon
15. Tomahawk and Warhammer  The battle axe can be used as an axe, dealing 200% damage to the target when hovering, and can destroy the target's secondary items. Warhammer can be used as a pickaxe, dealing an additional 6 points of damage to skeletons
16. Composite steel heavy equipment  Increase your strength
17. Copper alloy equipment  Being beaten will trigger lightning attacks on the attacker

This mod is currently in its first version. If there are any vulnerabilities, please send feedback via private message on my Bilibili account!
